content: अधिः [आधीयते दुःखमनेन आधा कि वा. पृ˚ ह्रस्वः] .²1 Mental pain or agony. See आधिः .²2 A woman in her courses. (= अवि.)

अधि {%ind.%} .²1 (As a prefix to verbs) over, above; (अधिकार); ˚स्था to stand over; ˚कृ to place over or at the head of; ˚रुह् to grow over or above; over and above, besides, in addition to (आधिक्य); fully, completely (अतिशय, विशेष), to get something in addition to another; अधिगत्य जगत्यधीश्वरात् having obtained fully, अधि intensifying the meaning of the root; इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि <ls>Rv. 1. 6. 10</ls>; (अधीमहे आधिक्येन याचामहे). .²2 (As a separable adverb) Over, above, from above (mostly Vedic); षष्टिर्वीरासो अधि षट् <ls>Rv. 7. 18. 14</ls>. .²3 (As a preposition) with <ab>acc.</ab> .³({%a%}) Above, over, upon, in (उपरि); यं दन्तमधिजायते नाडी तं दन्तमुद्धरेत् <ls>Suśr.</ls> अध्यधि Just above; लोकानुपर्युपर्यास्तेऽधोऽधोऽध्यधि च माधवः Bopadeva; with <ab>gen.</ab> also; ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि <ls>Rv. 1. 19. 6</ls> above the sun; ˚विटपि <ls>Śi. 7. 35</ls>; ˚त्वत् <ls n="Śi.">7. 41</ls>; ˚रजनि at night. अधिरजनि जगाम धाम तस्याः <ls n="Śi. 7.">52</ls>. .³({%b%}) with reference to, concerning, in the case of, on the subject of (अधिकृत्य) (mostly in adverbial compounds in this sense); हरौ इति अधिहरि; so अधिस्त्रि; कृष्णमधिकृत्य प्रवृत्ता कथा अधिकृष्णम्; so ˚ज्योतिषम्, ˚लोकम्, ˚दैवम्, ˚दैवतम् treating of stars <ab>&c.</ab>; ˚पुरन्ध्रि <ls>Śi. 6. 32</ls> in the case of women. .³({%c%}) (With <ab>abl.</ab>) Just over, more than (अधिक); सत्त्वादधि महानात्मा <ls>Kaṭh.</ls>; अविदितादधि .³({%d%}) (With <ab>loc.</ab>) Over, on or upon, above (showing lordship or sovereignty over something) (ऐश्वर्य); अधिरीश्वरे <ls>P. I. 4. 97</ls>; अधि भुवि रामः <ls>P. II. 3. 9. Sk.</ls> Rāma rules over the earth; the country ruled over may be used with <ab>loc.</ab> of ‘ruler’; अधि रामे भूः {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%}; प्रहारवर्मण्यधि विदेहा जाताः <ls>Dk. 77</ls> subject to, under the government of, become the property or possession of (अधि denoting स्वत्वं in this case); under, inferior to (हीन); अधि हरौ सुराः (Bopadeva) the gods are under Hari. .²4 (As first member of Tatpuruṣa compounds) .³({%a%}) Chief, supreme, principal, presiding; ˚देवता presiding deity; ˚राजः supreme or sovereign ruler; ˚पतिः supreme lord <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%b%}) Redundant, superfluous (growing over another); ˚दन्तः = अध्यारूढः (दन्तस्योपरि जातः) दन्तः <ls>P. VI. 2. 188</ls>. .³({%c%}) Over, excessive; ˚अधिक्षेपः high censure. According to <ls>G. M.</ls> अधि has these senses. अधिरध्ययनैश्वर्यवशित्वस्मरणाधिके . {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%}; उपाध्यायादधीते; इङोऽध्ययनार्थकत्वस्य अधिद्योतकः; अधिपतिः (ऐश्वर्ये); अधीनः (वशित्वे) अधिगतः इनं; मातुरध्येति (स्मरणे); अधिकम् (अधिके). .²5 Instead of; इदमग्ने सुधितं दुर्धितादधि प्रियादु चिन्मन्मनः प्रेय अस्तु ते <ls>Rv. 1. 140. 11</ls>. In the Veda अधि is supposed by <ls>B. and R.</ls> to have the senses of ‘out of’, ‘from’, ‘of’, ‘among’, ‘before’, ‘beforehand’, ‘for’, ‘in favour of’, ‘in’, ‘at’.
